title: MemoryCandidatesDismissRequest
description: Lightweight consumption without a review decision (queue removal). Applies the §6.7 consumption scrub atomically; dismissal is replayable (§7.0.5). Grant: review covering the candidate capture_scope. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen; unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
